reply.windowClosed: After 24 hours, WhatsApp requires an approved message; you can reply when {name} responds.

reply.diverRemoved: This diver’s record was removed, so replies are switched off.

notices.failed: That did not send, so the message is still waiting on an answer.
notices.notConfigured: Email is not switched on for this DiveDay setup, so nothing went out.
notices.tooLong: That is longer than a reply can be. Trim it and send again.
notices.notFound: That message is no longer on this record.
notices.channelUnsupported: DiveDay cannot answer a text message yet.
notices.noReplyAddress: There is no address to answer on.
notices.cannotBeSent: This reply cannot be sent as it stands. Nothing went out, and trying again will not change that.
notices.whatsappWindowClosed: Their last WhatsApp message is more than 24 hours old, so WhatsApp won’t take a typed reply. Send one of the approved messages to ask them to write back.
notices.whatsappNotConnected: Answering on WhatsApp needs the sender you connect in Settings.
notices.reopenFailed: That did not reach WhatsApp. Try again in a minute, or call them.
notices.reopenWindowOpen: They wrote again in the last 24 hours, so type your reply instead.
notices.reopenAlreadyAsked: You already asked them to write back. Wait for their answer before asking again.
notices.notAuthorized: Your account can’t answer divers for this shop any more. Ask an owner or manager to check your access.
notices.lateMarked: Marked running late. The roster and the manifest show it.
notices.lateClosed: That seat is past running late: checked in, canceled, or the boat has sailed.
notices.gone: That message is no longer in the inbox.
